title: Isolate material configuration changes from re-enrollment in M5 composition tests
outcome: Prove material configuration-basis refusal independently of enrollment-generation refusal.
acceptance: The Configuration authority variant changes material endpoint/configuration without re-enrolling or borrowing the Enrollment variant's generation/link invalidation; it asserts the intended stale-configuration refusal.
The Enrollment variant remains independently tested; focused composition tests pass and review confirms each control isolates its named cause.
